## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and link the issue it resolves.

## Validation

- [ ] `bun run lint`
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `bun test`
- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behaviour changes.
- [ ] I added or updated documentation, examples, or both where the public API changed.

## Compatibility

- [ ] This is backwards compatible.
- [ ] This intentionally changes or removes a public API and is clearly described above.
